entities.summary: Henry Bannister Merwin, was an American poet, magazine editor, novelist, film director and screenwriter during the silent era. He wrote as many as 141 films between 1909 and 1921. He was associated with Edison Studios and the London Film Company. Merwin often wrote with his wife, Anne Merwin. Bannister Merwin was a authors & novelists from Lichfield (1873, Lichfield–1922-02-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
